text:
Priya: quick sync postmortem follow-up 1 need to lock remediation owners, SLO proposals, and a dashboard plan. who can pick up pieces?
Ben: I can own the remediation board and follow-ups. will create a lightweight tracker and weekly checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
Alex: I'll run sims for different SLO candidates (p50/p95/p99) and estimate impact on error budget and cost.
Nora: taking dashboards. plan: add rolling errorbudget burn, per-model p95/p99, and a GPU queue-depth panel. will annotate incident windows. ETA: Tue EOD.
Ben: noted a recurring pattern: bursts around 11:00-13:00 PST on Thursdays. looks like traffic spike + longer seq lengths. propose a scheduled replay job to validate mitigations.
Priya: SLO proposal (draft): keep latency p95 at 210ms, add throughput SLO for tail concurrency (95th percentile concurrent reqs per pod <= 100), and p99 < 600ms. also add an errorbudget burn alert when >10% consumed in 1h.
Alex: for autoscale/fallback policy, add a guard: disable model-variant fallback for the first 5m after a scale event to avoid oscillations. will add to runbook.
alert-bot: draft alert rule created: name=slo-high-burn-1h, condition=error_budget_burn_rate > 0.10 over 1h, severity=page.
Nora: question 1 automatic downgrade to smaller quantized variant saved cost during incident but produced quality regression in evals. product needs to sign off before we automate. add to meeting agenda.
Priya: action items recap: (1) Ben 1 remediation board + ownership rotation (2-week primary, 1-week secondary) + weekly sync (due in 3d); (2) Nora 1 dashboard widgets + annotations (ETA Tue EOD); (3) Alex 1 SLO sims and cost impact doc (due Mon); (4) Priya 1 schedule product review & update runbook; (5) infra 1 create replay load-test job for Thu pattern.
Ben: I'll also add the owner rotation schedule to the board and ping the oncall rotation for overlap.
Alex: I'll open a PR with simulated metrics and proposed alert thresholds. will include test scenarios (burst, steady-high, degradation).
Priya: I scheduled product review with @product-sla Wed 09:00 PT 1 invite sent. agenda: throughput SLO, fallback policy, quality guardrails.
alert-bot: follow-up reminder set for check-in at 1765035700.
Nora: I'll post dashboard screenshots once panels are up.
Ben: tagging infra to validate autoscale override threshold: concurrency > 100 triggers override to add pods; also add gpu_queue_length > 75 for 2m as a burst detector.
Alex: thanks all. we'll reconvene after product sign-off; please surface blockers in this thread.
